positions.locationName: Culver City, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: • Implemented serialization of network packets for a distributed animation system on Unity and Unreal.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Project Lead
positions.description:
• Project Lead of an outdoor AR art experience that involved 6 art pieces in 6 different cities across the world. Filed two patents around counteracting drift that occurs while walking extended distances during an AR experience. In addition to the technical design for 5 of the pieces, I lead the on site calibration and technical planning at each location. Unity, ARKit
• Senior Software Engineer on Justice League VR. Built a level on a short time frame.
• Senior Engineer on a table top AR experience. Unreal, ARKit

positions.title: Software Engineer - R&D
positions.description:
Live broadcast tool
• Designed and implemented cross-platform architecture for rendering system (C++)
• UI for the Windows broadcast client, including asynchronous networking during front end animations (C#)
• Coding, debugging, memory management for OSX broadcast client (Objective C)
InPvP (game server for Minecraft Pocket Edition) 
• Designed and implemented AI for enemy movement and combat (first of its kind for pocket edition), a camera system that reacted to in-game action, and a chat bot for communicating with the audience watching a live game stream (C#)
• Live camera control webpage implemented with PHP, html and C# API.

positions.title: Software Engineer - R&D
positions.description:
MaxSim (air traffic control simulator/trainer)
•	Implemented 3D shadows using a cascading shadow map with normal offsets to reduce artifacts. (C++, DirectX and HLSL)
•	Utilized the SilverLining library to implement weather simulation.
•	Designed and implemented various improvements to a graphics engine involving shaders, animation and UI.
•	Worked remotely.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
NCAA Football 14 
• Oversaw and supported remote engineers developing features for the game. 
• Created a system to minimize the number of repeated cutscenes during randomized cutscene sequences. 
• During alpha, focused on addressing bugs related to in-game commentary. 
• Developed and debugged game utilizing PS3 and Xbox 360 development kits.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Optimized the Unreal Engine 3 to run on the Android platform, including hardware acceleration with VPU calls. First game using UE3 running on Android.
• Utilized the Unreal Engine 3 to develop games for PC, iOS, and Android. 
• Worked with Objective C, Java and JavaScript in development of mobile apps. 
• Developed screens using Flash and ActionScript to display aggregated social media data for AT&T. 
• Developed a payment website in C#.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed, maintained, and debugged software for the MaxSim system - a simulator used to train air traffic controllers. (C++ Linux)
• Critical member in developing and rapidly improving a security system simulator used to train security teams at a nuclear facility (C++ Windows)
• Voice-enabled an artillery strike simulator, so that spoken commands could control a wide variety of options and then reply with text to speech messages.

positions.title: CEO
positions.description:
• Produced, designed, directed, and programmed the game for the Nintendo Wii. 
• Developed and released title for WiiWare download in the Americas (C++, Wii RVL SDK, Radix, Codewarrior). 
• Reduced production costs and increased productivity because game ran on PC (DirectX) as well as the Wii throughout development cycle. 
• Discovered and coordinated contractors for the creation of art assets, music and sound effects, the script, localization (internationalization), and programming; over a dozen people worked on the game on and off-site.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Superman Returns
• Worked on a variety of areas including the animation system, User Interface, sound, graphics, and  technical design documentation. 
• Coordinated the technical implementation of the localization of the project. 
NCAA Football 08
• Developed the trophy system which involved coordinating with the art team, rendering  them in the ‘shrine,’ the save game system, and the UI menus.
